mentions.name: Careless Whisper
mentions.description: A local dictation app that transcribes spoken dictations faster than cloud tools, completing transcription in under 2 seconds regardless of dictation length.
mentions.problem: Cloud dictation tools are slower, especially for longer dictations.
mentions.source_excerpt: Making local running dictations transcribe faster than cloud tools even for longer dictations. <2.0 seconds for any length of dictation.

evidence.value: Making local running dictations transcribe faster than cloud tools even for longer dictations. <2.0 seconds for any length of dictation.

mentions.name: Careless Whisper
mentions.description: A local-first voice dictation app that makes long dictations (even over 10 minutes) appear in under 2 seconds by pushing what is possible with current STT models. All processing is done locally with zero network calls.
mentions.problem: Long dictations (even over 10 minutes) are slow to appear with current speech-to-text models.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Voice interfaces. Currently this dictation app https://carelesswhisper.app

Managed to make long dictations even >10mins appear in < 2seconds by pushing what is possible with current STT models.

All processing done locally with 0 network calls.
